Welcome to the Cornell MPH Biostatistics website — a central home for course materials, syllabi, schedules, and workshops for the Biostatistics curriculum in the Cornell Master of Public Health program.

## Courses

### [VTPEH 6105 — Biostatistics for Health Sciences](6105/index.qmd)

Core biostatistics concepts and applied data analysis in R for public health.

### [VTPEH 6270 — Advanced Biostatistics](6270/6270/index.qmd)

Continuation course covering advanced methods, multivariate models, and applied analyses.
